response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial expertise, strong software engineering practices, and distributed systems experience that are relevant to routing infrastructure. However, he has significant gaps in the primary technical requirements: his last modern C++ experience was over 11 years ago (2014-2015), and he has no Rust experience—both explicitly required for this role. While his demonstrated ability to learn systems programming languages (D Lang) and his track record of picking up new technologies suggest adaptability, the lack of current C++ proficiency and absence of navigation/routing pipeline domain experience create substantial onboarding risks for a mid-senior IC role requiring immediate productivity.
strengths: Strong geospatial data expertise from GISCollective platform and Green Map Association web GIS applications, demonstrating relevant domain knowledge
Demonstrated software engineering excellence with testing-first mindset, TDD practices, and creation of testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Experience building distributed systems at scale (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/second) with asynchronous I/O, caching, and microservices architecture
concerns: No recent modern C++ experience—last C++ work was 2014-2015 (11+ years ago); job requires current modern C++ as primary language; no Rust experience offered as alternative
Recent professional trajectory focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than systems-level programming, suggesting skills may have atrophied in required area
Geospatial background is primarily web-based GIS applications; lacks specific experience with navigation systems, routing algorithms, and data optimization pipelines required for this role
